newsFlag.summary: Juszczyk missed Tuesday practice due to an ongoing finger injury, though his absence may be veteran management as he practiced Monday.
Undisclosed
Personal
Mike Evans is dealing with a groin/adductor injury and will miss practice this week, with hopes to return next week ahead of the season opener on September 10 in Australia.
Jason Myers is active and healthy but showing reduced accuracy in preseason games after a strong 2025 regular season performance.
Darren Waller is being eased into the Panthers offense after recently signing and is expected to miss the preseason finale, but there is no injury designation reported.
Mariota returned to practice Monday after missing two weeks with a sprained MCL in his right knee and is working to increase his workload ahead of the 2026 season.
Undisclosed
McCaffrey participated in full practice drills including running and catching passes, showing positive progress with an undisclosed injury as he approaches Week 1.
Kittle is being eased back into practice after Achilles injury and his availability for Week 1 against the Rams remains uncertain despite activation from PUP list.

Watson was named the Browns' starting quarterback after winning a job battle, though he has a history of significant injuries including a torn Achilles tendon and re-rupture that caused him to miss the entire 2025 season.
James Conner has been placed on injured reserve with a designation to return due to ongoing foot injury complications, requiring him to miss at least the first four games of the season.
Mitchell Trubisky is dealing with a biceps injury and missed Wednesday's practice, but the issue is not considered serious and he remains day-to-day.
Patrick Mahomes is on track to start Week 1 despite recovering from a torn left ACL, with improving confidence in his readiness for the season opener.
Alvin Kamara sustained an MCL sprain and is expected to be out for at least one month, putting his Week 1 availability in jeopardy and making him a candidate to open the season on injured reserve.
McNichols was placed on injured reserve with a quadriceps injury and won't be eligible to return until at least Week 5 of the 2026 season.
Ray-Ray McCloud was placed on injured reserve by the Bears with an undisclosed injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season.
Christian Kirk was placed on injured reserve with a calf injury and must miss at least four games to start the regular season.
Lamar Jackson is fully healthy heading into the 2026 season after hamstring and back injuries limited him in 2025.
DJ Moore suffered an ankle injury in a preseason game but has returned to practice and is expected to be available for Week 1 against the Texans.

Jakobi Meyers jammed his right hand during Wednesday's joint practice and is wearing a brace, with uncertainty about practicing this week and potential availability for the preseason finale against Tampa Bay on August 28.
D.J. Montgomery was placed on injured reserve by the Colts due to an abdominal injury and is expected to miss the entire 2026 season unless he reaches an injury settlement.
Undisclosed
David Sills was placed on injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and cannot return until at least Week 5.
Ty Johnson remains sidelined with a lower leg injury but has resumed running and sprinting, with limited fantasy relevance due to his backup role behind James Cook and Ray Davis.
Undisclosed
Metcalf dealt with an undisclosed injury during training camp but has returned to practice and is expected to be ready for Week 1 against the Falcons.
Achilles
Josh Jacobs was placed on the Commissioner's Exempt List due to misdemeanor charges from a domestic incident and is ineligible to practice or play until his legal situation is resolved.
Dobbins was cleared to return to practice after recovering from a soft-tissue injury and is expected to be Denver's top running back despite sitting out preseason games.
Pittman is expected to be ready for Week 1 after missing practice time and preseason action due to a hamstring injury, but has returned to practice and will have time to ramp up before the opener.
AJ Dillon played in the preseason game and is active, but could see increased role if other Panthers RBs (Hubbard and Etienne) suffer lingering injuries.
Jeudy will not play in the Browns' preseason game against the Bills, though the reason is not specified and appears to be a routine preseason rest decision rather than an injury concern.
Tee Higgins has a heel contusion that he'll manage ahead of Week 1, but coach Zac Taylor indicated he should be ready to play against the Buccaneers on Sept. 13.
Chuba Hubbard returned to practice Tuesday after a hamstring injury and is trending positively toward season availability.
Hamstring
Jermar Jefferson was reverted to the Vikings' injured reserve with an undisclosed injury and will miss the entire 2026 regular season.
Ben Skowronek suffered a concussion in Thursday's preseason game and entered the NFL's five-step concussion protocol, requiring clearance from an independent neurologist before he can play in Week 1.
Ja'Marr Chase is dealing with a left knee hyperextension suffered during practice but is expected to be limited in practice this week and should be ready for the Week 1 matchup against Tampa Bay.
DeVonta Smith is a full participant in practice after returning in limited capacity the previous week, indicating continued recovery from a hamstring injury.
Travis Etienne is healthy and positioned to receive an increased workload after teammate Alvin Kamara sustained an MCL sprain expected to sideline him for at least a month.
Trey Sermon was placed on injured reserve by the Falcons with an undisclosed injury and is unavailable for the 2026 season unless waived with an injury settlement.
Knee
Cole Turner was waived/injured by the Dolphins and reverted to injured reserve with an undisclosed injury, requiring an injury settlement to have any chance to play in 2026.
Grant Calcaterra was placed on injured reserve with a back injury and will be sidelined until at least Week 5.
Bo Melton's roster spot is uncertain due to poor preseason performance and competition from other receivers, though he is currently active and healthy.
Irvin Charles was placed on injured reserve with a designation to return after suffering an undisclosed preseason injury, sidelining him for at least four weeks with earliest return in Week 5.
Isiah Pacheco was placed on injured reserve due to a back injury sustained during training camp, along with an MCL sprain, and will miss at least the first four games of the season.

Rachaad White is sidelined with a hamstring injury and will miss the Commanders' final two preseason games, though he is making progress in recovery.
Khalil Shakir has been sidelined with an undisclosed injury since Aug. 20 and missed the final two preseason games, leaving less than two weeks to recover before the regular season opener.
Ty Chandler suffered a season-ending knee injury during a preseason game and has been placed on injured reserve, missing the entire 2026 season.

Oladokun was waived with an injury designation and reverted to the Chiefs' injured reserve list, where he is expected to remain for the entire 2026 regular season unless waived with an injury settlement.

Kenneth Walker III is dealing with ankle swelling but is expected to be fine with no concern for extended absence.

Kendre Miller sustained a minor injury at practice but avoided any serious setback and has a chance to be available.
